name: How long does it take to complete an accessibility bathroom modification?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete an accessibility bathroom modification?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an accessibility bathroom modification depends on the complexity and extent of the renovation. Simple installations like grab bars may take a day or two. More extensive projects, such as a full bathroom remodel with a curbless shower and wider doorways, could take several weeks. We provide an estimated project timeline after our initial assessment and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary from a few days for minor changes to several weeks for extensive renovations.
